correctness.rationale: A complete 5,950-face enumeration and directed 27,216-incidence topological sort certify an acyclic Morse matching with exactly one critical zero-cell and 46 critical three-cells. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces and independently constructed vertex-orbit independence recurrences agree in each of 22 group classes and across all 1,296 group elements. The generated 22 irreducible wreath characters are verified orthonormal, and exact integer class sums produce precisely seven one-copy irreducibles with dimensions totaling 46. The finite-group rational quotient transfer is standard and all normalization signs are derived in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Recent binary-hypercube equivariant homology theory motivates the natural nonbinary ternary isometry representation. Determining every conjugacy-class trace and all seven irreducible components is substantially more than the previously known 46-dimensional Betti vector space. The uniquely alphabet-fixed line with sign coordinate action and rational acyclicity of the full symmetry quotient are nontrivial structural consequences. No general or downstream theorem is claimed or needed for this natural exact invariant.
